cases.description: Subcategory collection: in the Site link the snapshot holds Toposolid 2 and its subcategory group Sub-divisions 8, keyed by the subcategory id, named plainly and carrying Toposolid as parent
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with every link loaded and open the Model Context panel; Scope 'Whole model'.
Check the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Site' link in the document list.
On the Explorer tab expand the Site link: Toposolid shows 2 and its child Sub-divisions shows 8 (the parent row reads 10 when the tree nests children).
Check without the panel: open the Site model (do not save), select every toposolid and sub-division and read the Properties count per category: 2 Toposolid, 8 Sub-divisions.

cases.description: Subcategories of Site, Lines and Topography (base and survey points, internal origin, sketch lines, contours) and every Center line subcategory (ducts, duct fittings, flex ducts, pipes, conduits, cable trays) never become groups, in the Current model and in the Site link
cases.expected: no snapshot group whose parent is Site, Lines or Topography, and no Center line group
manualSteps: Open the sample with every link loaded and the Model Context panel; Scope 'Whole model'; check Current model and the Site link.
Expand the Categories box and the Explorer tree: no Project Base Point, Survey Point, Internal Origin, <Sketch> or Primary Contours row appears, under Site, Lines, Topography or on its own.
Expand Ducts and Duct Fittings: no Center line row appears under them.

cases.description: Box Hide reaches By Host View links: a category hide (T2) on Walls removes the walls of the Current model and of every By Host View link from the active {3D} view collector, inside Temporary View Properties; Reset brings every count back
cases.expected: Walls 0 in every document after Hide; temporary view properties on; counts as before after Reset
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view; every link By Host View (Visibility/Graphics > Revit Links).
In the panel, Categories box, click the eye of Walls: the walls of the HVAC model and of the Architectural link disappear, and the view title shows Temporary View Properties.
Click Reset on the temporary bar: every wall is back.

cases.description: Parent overrides children for Hide: a category hide of Toposolid with its subcategory Sub-divisions removes all 10 Site link elements from the {3D} view collector; Reset brings them back
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view with the Site link By Host View.
In the Categories box click the eye of Toposolid: the 2 toposolids and the 8 sub-divisions of the Site link disappear; Sub-divisions reads hidden too.
Reset: all 10 are back.

cases.description: Revit keeps a subcategory hidden under a hidden parent: with only Toposolid hidden (Sub-divisions left on), the 8 sub-divisions also leave the {3D} view collector. This is why the panel refuses Show on a child while its parent is hidden
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view with the Site link By Host View.
Visibility/Graphics > Model Categories: uncheck Toposolid and leave its Sub-divisions subcategory checked; the sub-divisions disappear too. Cancel the dialog.

cases.description: Box Color is a category override inside Temporary View Properties, which By Host View links follow: Walls get the panel color; Reset removes it. The drawn color of linked walls is checked on the images
cases.expected: category override color #F44336 on Walls with temporary view properties on; none after Reset
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view; every link By Host View.
Categories box: check only Walls, right-click > Color, pick red: the walls of the HVAC model and of the Architectural link turn red.
Reset: the colors are gone.

cases.description: Keep leaves a category hide in place: after a box Hide of Walls, Keep does not end Temporary View Properties, Walls stay hidden in every document; Reset ends it
cases.expected: after Keep: temporary view properties on, Walls 0; after Reset: counts as before
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view. Categories box: eye of Walls (hidden).
Click Keep on the temporary bar: the walls stay hidden and the bar still counts the change.
Click Reset: the walls are back.

cases.description: A link that keeps its own settings (Custom) is not reached by a box action; the panel returns the one-line notice 'Links By Linked View or Custom keep their own settings.'
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view. Visibility/Graphics > Revit Links: set the Architectural link to Custom (leave its categories as they are).
Categories box: eye of Walls. The panel says 'Links By Linked View or Custom keep their own settings.' and the Architectural walls stay drawn.
Reset, then set the link back to By Host View.

cases.description: Parent overrides children on a link row: Color on the Site link's Toposolid row makes one 'Model Context <n>' view filter whose categories are Toposolid and Sub-divisions; Reset deletes it
cases.expected: one panel filter with categories {Toposolid, Sub-divisions}; none after Reset
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view with the Site link By Host View.
Explorer: right-click the Site link's Toposolid row > Color, pick red: all 10 elements turn red.
Visibility/Graphics > Filters lists one 'Model Context <n>' filter; Edit/New shows its categories Toposolid and Sub-divisions.
Reset: the filter is gone.

cases.description: Latest wins between view filters: child color then parent color puts the parent's filter above the child's; child color again puts the child's on top; Reset deletes both
cases.expected: order after parent: parent, child; after child again: child, parent; no panel filter after Reset
manualSteps: Make '{3D}' the active view with the Site link By Host View.
Explorer: color Sub-divisions blue, then Toposolid red: all 10 are red (the parent wins).
Color Sub-divisions blue again: only the 8 sub-divisions are blue.
Visibility/Graphics > Filters shows the most recent 'Model Context <n>' first. Reset removes both.
